about: What the needs pass (gen_types.py merge_needs) cannot see in a function's code, each with why. A need is a scene object by its SceneObj_ name without the prefix, scene (the scene's holder of those objects), or another object the game makes later than the scene's objects (UserFile, CometScheduler, MarioActor: luma_hook.h). A row names one function (name, signature) or a class (class, except: each member function but the named ones). A row that names no function stops the build.

rows.name: MR::getSceneObjHolder
rows.why: it reads GameSystem's scene controller with no test (SceneObjHolder.cpp); the controller is null before the first scene

its user files, save handler, windows and save icon are made by initAfterResourceLoaded, once the system archive is loaded (some frames after a mod's start), and its functions use them with no test (SaveDataHandleSequence.cpp); GameDataFunction reaches the current file through getCurrentUserFile

rows.name: GameSequenceProgress::requestGalaxyMove
rows.why: it calls mGalaxyCometScheduler->syncWithFlags() with no test (GameSequenceProgress.cpp)

rows.name: MarioHolder::getMarioActor
rows.why: it gives mActor, null from the holder's making until MarioHolder::setMarioActor, some way into the scene's making (MarioActor::init)
